phrases.text: First of all, I want to say thank you.

translations.es: Antes que nada, quiero decir gracias.
translations.en: First of all, I want to say thank you.

phrases.text: On the other hand, it is too expensive.

translations.es: Por otro lado, es demasiado caro.
translations.en: On the other hand, it is too expensive.

phrases.text: Because of that, I can't go with you.

translations.es: Por eso, no puedo ir contigo.
translations.en: Because of that, I can't go with you.

phrases.text: In conclusion, it was a really good day.

translations.es: En conclusión, fue un día realmente bueno.
translations.en: In conclusion, it was a really good day.

phrases.text: However, I think we should wait a bit.

translations.es: Sin embargo, creo que deberíamos esperar un poco.
translations.en: However, I think we should wait a bit.

phrases.text: Furthermore, we need more time to finish.

translations.es: Además, necesitamos más tiempo para terminar.
translations.en: Furthermore, we need more time to finish.

phrases.text: For example, you can take the bus.

translations.es: Por ejemplo, puedes tomar el autobús.
translations.en: For example, you can take the bus.
